permission.name: Correo.propio-centro-supervisor
permission.condition: self.centro IN (SELECT cu.centro FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuario cu JOIN cu.centroUsuarioTipoUsuario cut JOIN cut.tipoUsuario tu WHERE cu.usuario = ? AND tu.codigo = 'SUPERVISOR')

permission.name: Adjunto.propio-centro-supervisor
